description: Returns the user-facing recommendation for one pattern (workflow, sourced effects, needs, risks, a first step) and, in an internal part, the full pattern with every claim resolved to its sources (title, publisher, URL, date read, location) and evidence level, or marked as having no source. The internal part answers questions such as what the advice is based on.

lang.description: Language of the result: sl, en, de or hr. Texts not yet translated are returned in English and marked in the result.

sections.description: Sections of the internal part to return; when left out: approaches, prerequisites, effect, risks, compliance

name: adoption_get_pattern
title: Get adoption pattern details
